directive: Abandon the current fishing-bank cycle immediately. Inspect inventory and nearby ground items now; pick up reachable valuable loot, then bank useful items or find a reachable merchant/shop and sell low-value surplus if capacity is pressured. Do not fish or attack again until loot/capacity is resolved. Choose a different measurable progression objective afterward, such as a new skill, route, NPC interaction, equipment upgrade, or profitable resource activity. Do not repeat the same objective without a new XP, item, coin, level, prerequisite, or discovery milestone.
